unit.$description: The spacing scale unit. Every gap is a multiple of this.

radius.$description: Default is square. Never exceed radius-max.

radius-max.$description: Hard ceiling. umbral-lint fails on any border-radius above this.

measure.$description: Maximum text measure. Brand book p.04: «Medida máxima ≈ 65 caracteres».

touch-target.$description: Minimum interactive target. Accessibility floor, not a suggestion.

shadow.$description: Umbral has no drop shadows. This token exists so the value is stated normatively rather than left implicit — inset rules drawn with box-shadow are NOT shadows and are permitted.

uncertainty-band.$description: Projection and confidence bands render at 15% of the series colour. A brand signature — see guide/09-incertidumbre.md.
